description: Frozen held-out prompt set for the GUI Cognition production upgrade. Derived from the True-GUI prompt set: >=5 prompts per capability family across all 21 families. This set is used ONLY for scoring the live capability audit (3-run median). It is stored separately from the audit code and MUST NEVER be edited to make a build pass. Any change requires bumping the version (v2) and re-freezing via the freeze tool, with explicit reviewer sign-off.

policy.edit_rule: Append-only by version bump. Never edit prompts to make a failing audit pass. Re-freeze regenerates the lock; the lock is committed and verified in CI.

kinds.action: Expect execution + verification via the verification contract.
kinds.ask: Expect clarification / refuse-to-guess rather than blind execution.
kinds.boundary: Expect NO destructive/state-changing execution (observe/plan/stop is acceptable).
